description: P1 it02: gridlock fix via faster car-following (M1, M5, M6), seeker share 0.12 and q 15 m for M10a, red running kept at 0.5 (M3), early_start raised (M2), jmTimegapMinor lowered (M7).

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car (sim 1.2-1.6 s vs obs 0.35 s in every it01 spec), M5/length (65 m vs 15.8 m) and the car M6 approach times: tau 2.5 -> 1.8 s and accel 1.2 -> 1.8 m/s2 shorten the discharge headway and let the queue clear in the green. decel and minGap stay at Saval.
Same values as car_saval (no rule acts on custom2 on this net) so M1/car and M5/length move the same way for both car groups.

Targets M1/moto (0.83-1.0 s vs 0.296 s), M5/length and M5/moto_density (0.09 vs 0.052 veh/m2): accel 1.1 -> 2.0, tau 0.8 -> 0.7, minGap 1.9 -> 1.2 give faster discharge and a shorter queue footprint; minGapLat stays at the lower bound 0.3 (M4). Share 0.9 -> 0.88 only because moto_seeker rises to 0.12 (M10a).

Riding values as moto_saval. Share 0.1 -> 0.12: with share 0.1, q = 15 m it01_s01 gave M10a 0.48 veh/cycle vs obs 0.56 (share 0.3 gave 3.17, 0.25 gave 2.24, far above), so a small raise; M8/moto is not reachable here (wrong lane is not applicable on this net).

Targets M7a/release_time (sim 24-27 s vs obs 2.78 s) and M7b/clear_lag (11.7-15.1 s vs 5.46 s) and M7c/slope (0.43-0.64 vs 0.29): jmTimegapMinor 1.0 -> 0.6 s lets box waiters accept smaller gaps and leave earlier; riding values as the other motorcycle archetypes.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/share/moto: p0 = 0.5 gave 0.104 (s00) and 0.095 (s03) vs obs 0.098 and M3/per_cycle 2.8 vs 3.9, while p0 = 0.15 gave 0.015; so 0.5 is kept and k stays 0.

Targets M2/early/moto (sim 0.016-0.021 vs obs 0.130) and M2/first_delay (5.3 s vs 2.8 s): p = 0.13 produced only about a sixth of the observed share (many starters do not cross before green), so p is raised to 0.5 and the window set to 10 s, the upper end of the 4-10 s target lead time.

Targets M10a/per_cycle (0.56 veh/cycle) and the observed queue at choice 15.3-15.7 m (M10b, M9c): q = 15 m and the p values of it01_s01 (the closest to M10a, 0.48), where wrong_lane and right_lane are redistributed so the sidewalk is the only usable option; v_creep and merge_zone_m unchanged.
